# Main X Index (main-x-service)

> A federated identity index: ~55 self-contained Rust crates (loco.rs
> backend services + SvelteKit operator front-ends), one per real-world
> entity (person, worker, place, thing, event, course, organization,
> care pathway, case, plan/portfolio), each doing CRUD, probabilistic +
> deterministic matching, full-text search, record merge, an audit
> trail, and event streaming — plus a central SSO provider, a
> cross-service link-graph aggregator, and five consumer applications
> that build on the registries.

Each crate is self-contained (own REST API, own persistence, own
matching algorithm) and shares an architecture and documentation
layout, not code. Every subproject's `spec/` directory is the single
source of truth for that subproject; code conforms to the spec, not
the reverse. Repository: https://github.com/SixArm/main-x-service and
https://codeberg.org/SixArm/main-x-service (the same history, pushed
to both). License: Rust crates `MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR
GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only`; front-ends `MIT OR Apache-2.0` — see
[LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md).

- [index.md](index.md): repo root navigation (subprojects, examples, running, architecture snapshot)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the full subproject index plus CI, spec-driven-development, and shared-doc wiring
- [agents/share/overview.md](agents/share/overview.md): the honest per-crate capability matrix — what each crate actually has today
- [agents/share/architecture.md](agents/share/architecture.md): the layered request flow and the two internal service shapes
- [AI_STATEMENT.md](AI_STATEMENT.md): how AI tools are used to develop this software, and the bounds on that use
- [tasks.md](tasks.md): the live, repo-spanning work queue
- [plan.md](plan.md): cross-subproject planning
- [tutorials/](tutorials/): six live-verified walkthroughs — [01 getting started](tutorials/01-getting-started.md), [02 identity lifecycle](tutorials/02-identity-lifecycle.md), [03 auth & ABAC](tutorials/03-authentication-abac.md), [04 cross-service linking](tutorials/04-cross-service-linking.md), [05 bulk import/export](tutorials/05-bulk-import-export.md), [06 the event bus](tutorials/06-event-bus.md)
- [examples/](examples/): runnable reference material — [compose/](examples/compose/) Podman stacks, [data/](examples/data/) synthetic fixtures, [policies/](examples/policies/) ABAC policy cookbook, [api/](examples/api/) per-service `.http` collections
- [sixarm-services-skill/](sixarm-services-skill/SKILL.md): a Claude Code skill explaining this system's concepts, terminology, and worked examples
- [sixarm-services-maintainer-skill/](sixarm-services-maintainer-skill/SKILL.md): a Claude Code skill for making a code/spec/infrastructure change here

## Entity registry services (Rust, loco.rs)

- [person-service](person/person-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Person (general) identity registry
- [worker-service](worker/worker-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Worker (workforce/professional) identity registry, plus assessments
- [place-service](place/place-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Place registry (schema.org/Place)
- [thing-service](thing/thing-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Thing/asset registry (schema.org/Thing)
- [event-service](event/event-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Time-bounded event registry (schema.org/Event)
- [course-service](course/course-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Course-identity registry plus CourseInstance sub-resource
- [authentication-service](authentication/authentication-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Central SSO — passwordless magic-link, cookie sessions, PASETO v4.public issuance
- [organization-service](organization/organization-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Organization registry (schema.org/Organization); family FHIR reference implementation
- [care-pathway-service](care-pathway/care-pathway-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Clinical care-pathway registry
- [case-service](case/case-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Governmental case-tracking registry
- [project-portfolio-management-service](project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Plan registry — one recursive tree; a full PM suite (goals/tasks/issues/timeline/burndown)

## Matcher crates (dependency-light comparison libraries)

- [person-matcher](person/person-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Demographic + multinational national-identifier matching
- [worker-matcher](worker/worker-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Workforce/professional identity matching
- [place-matcher](place/place-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Geographic/postal-address/venue matching
- [thing-matcher](thing/thing-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Generic thing/asset matching
- [event-matcher](event/event-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Time-bounded event matching
- [course-matcher](course/course-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Course matching (name, code, level, keywords)
- [organization-matcher](organization/organization-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Organization matching (name, address, LEI/DUNS/GLN/…)
- [care-pathway-matcher](care-pathway/care-pathway-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Clinical care-pathway matching
- [case-matcher](case/case-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Governmental case matching
- [project-portfolio-management-matcher](project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management-matcher-rust-crate/spec/index.md): Plan matching (no kind gate)

## Library crates (peer-side, not services or matchers)

- [authentication-verifier](authentication/authentication-verifier-rust-crate/index.md): Offline PASETO v4.public (Ed25519) verification; published to crates.io
- [integrity-mac](integrity/integrity-mac-rust-crate/): Keyed integrity MACs (HMAC-SHA256) with production-grade key handling, embedded family-wide
- [entity-ref](link/entity-ref-rust-crate/): The `EntityRef` URN type + the closed v1 `EdgeKind` registry for cross-service linking; published to crates.io as `entity-ref`

## Cross-cutting services

- [link-graph-service-with-loco](link/link-graph-service-with-loco/spec/index.md): Read-model aggregator for cross-service entity linking; carries the family's original OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter

## GitHub Pages

- [main-x-service.github.io/](main-x-service.github.io/index.md): Public documentation front door for this monorepo (SvelteKit + Lily Design System, static/prerendered); published via `git subtree` to a sibling read-only repo, see [spec/monorepo-github-pages/](spec/monorepo-github-pages/index.md)

## Front-end projects (SvelteKit operator SPAs)

- [person-front-end-with-svelte](person/person-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Person CRUD/search/match/merge/audit
- [worker-front-end-with-svelte](worker/worker-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Worker
- [place-front-end-with-svelte](place/place-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Place
- [thing-front-end-with-svelte](thing/thing-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Thing
- [event-front-end-with-svelte](event/event-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Event
- [course-front-end-with-svelte](course/course-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Course
- [authentication-front-end-with-svelte](authentication/authentication-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Passwordless magic-link sign up/in/out UI
- [organization-front-end-with-svelte](organization/organization-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for Organization
- [care-pathway-front-end-with-svelte](care-pathway/care-pathway-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for care pathways
- [case-front-end-with-svelte](case/case-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI for governmental cases
- [project-portfolio-management-front-end-with-svelte](project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management-front-end-with-svelte/spec/index.md): Operator UI plus Kanban/Gantt/burndown project-management views

## Consumer applications (build on the registries)

- [case-folder](case-folder/spec/index.md): NHS paper case-note folder location tracking
- [patient-flow](patient-flow/spec/index.md): NHS hospital bed management and ward whiteboards
- [workforce-planning-management](workforce-planning-management/spec/index.md): All-in-one HR across the employee lifecycle
- [contact-relationship-management](contact-relationship-management/spec/index.md): Customer/prospect relationships (sales, marketing, service, support)
- [content-management-system](content-management-system/spec/index.md): Headless content management (block documents, assets, editorial lifecycle)

## Continuous integration & policy

- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml) and [.woodpecker.yml](.woodpecker.yml): the CI pipelines (fmt, clippy, test, test-db, deny, evidence, fuzz, msrv, bench)
- [scripts/ci-check.sh](scripts/ci-check.sh): run any CI stage locally, exactly as CI runs it
- [ci/msrv.txt](ci/msrv.txt): the declared Minimum Supported Rust Version (current stable minus two)
- [ci/db-suites.txt](ci/db-suites.txt): the allowlist of crates whose `--ignored` Postgres suite runs in CI
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution ground rules
- [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md): sole-maintainer governance
- [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md): per-subproject SPDX license expressions
